name: Bisimbre (Spain)
description: Red field with a blue wavy pale edged yellow towards the hoist and a blue wavy fess edged yellow to the fly, charged at the hoist with a yellow monument.
history: Municipal flag of Bisimbre; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: vertical wavy stripe edged yellow towards the hoist
horizontal wavy stripe edged yellow across the fly
edges of the stripes and monument (peirón) at the hoist
